definitions.explanation: Substances consumed for nutrition; things that are eaten.

notes:
A more formal/technical term for food compared to ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食物|しょくもつ}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧ (food allergy)
- ⟦{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧ (dietary fiber)
- ⟦{食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ}→食物連鎖：08437_shokumotsurensa⟧ (food chain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧ (food - everyday term)
- {食物|しょくもつ} (food - technical/formal)
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧ (food products - commercial)
- ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧ (provisions, food supplies)
- ⟦{食糧|しょくりょう}→食糧：03762_shokuryou⟧ (provisions, rations - often for emergencies)

USAGE:
{食物|しょくもつ} is used in scientific, medical, and formal contexts rather than everyday conversation.
